title: argyroderma × necopinum
intro: Argyroderma × necopinum, commonly known as the 'Dune Button', is a succulent plant species. It is known for its small, white flowers and is native to the deserts of South Africa. The Dune Button plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing and skin protection. The bioactive constituents of Argyroderma × necopinum include flavonoids and other polyphenolic compounds, which may contribute to its potential therapeutic effects.
